concept.title: Set up a Microsoft Teams integration
concept.shortdesc: You can configure the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console to send event notifications to all users on a new or existing channel in Microsoft Teams. The Microsoft Teams integration supports events from all services in the Hybrid Cloud Console and uses incoming webhooks to receive event data.

conbody.p: If you have any issues with integrating the Hybrid Cloud Console with Microsoft Teams, contact Red Hat for support. To open a Red Hat support case directly from the Hybrid Cloud Console:

ol.li: Click Help (the ? icon) to open the help panel.
Select the My support cases tab.
Click Open a support case and add information about the issue.

conbody.p: Microsoft will not provide troubleshooting. The Hybrid Cloud Console integration with Microsoft Teams is fully supported by Red Hat.
